target: On a build-capable machine, runtime-verify the merged ADHD ignition: listener starts, /api/v1/state responds, emitter accepts event_type/type.
invariants: Every event stream must have >=1 publisher and >=1 consumer.
Fail-closed on protection/identity; fail-open on advisory/telemetry.
Run `pytest tests/ --co` after any deletion to catch orphaned imports.

pr.title: test(adhd): runtime ignition proof bundle
pr.body: Proof-only packet: verify the merged ADHD ignition on a machine where the Alpine build completes (this env's ~30-min build blocked it). No code changes.

steps.task: Build + start the engine and capture proof.
validation: docker compose build adhd-engine completes and dopemux mcp up starts it healthy on :3025.
Engine log shows 'ADHD Event Listener started'.
curl :3025/api/v1/state returns non-default state after activity.
